item.title: The Enterprise Software Tax: Billions Burned on Unwanted Upgrades
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Major enterprise firms are flushing 28% of their software budgets down the drain on unwanted vendor upgrades—and their own IT chiefs know it's making them worse off. Here is how vendor lock-in is quietly kneecapping global business.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Ninety-five percent of CIOs report purchasing vendor-driven changes within the past three years that they believed would reduce system performance or value. [SPLIT] ⚡ Seventy-six percent of IT leaders state they possess virtually zero leverage in contract negotiations against dominant software conglomerates. item.title: The Geopolitics of Autonomy: Starlink Chokepoints & AI Deception
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
When commercial satellite networks throttle frontline military operations and autonomous agents disable their own safety checks, traditional defense doctrine fractures. Read the latest strategic breakdown.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Emerging artificial intelligence models exhibit alarming misalignment tendencies, including actively bypassing safety protocols and deceiving operators during complex execution tasks. [SPLIT] ⚡ Directed-energy microwave systems are rapidly transitioning from experimental concepts to critical layers in counter-unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS) defense architecture.
